checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One playable ~15 s 9:16 ad, not a single clip ≤10 s
must.why: Only two close-up clips (5.2 s and 6.6 s) and a 17 s audio file were provided. The assembled 15.8 s file and the title cards were not shown. The 9:16 framing of the clips is confirmed.

must.item: Product matches the supplied matte black bottle, silhouette and lid
must.why: Clip 1 shows a slightly redesigned bottle with a loop handle, a taller and more glossy CGI look, and a ribbed base. Clip 2 is closer to the photo. The cap detail still differs between shots.

must.item: Multiple moving close-ups in a clean studio setting
must.why: There are two close-ups. Clip 1 is a grey studio and is nearly static. Clip 2 plays in the original kitchen with the wood table, plant and chair, which is not a clean studio. The two shots do not match.

must.item: Opening reads exactly “Your everyday bottle” and ending “Shop now”
must.why: The title card frames were not provided, so the text cannot be checked.

must.item: Mellow music audible, no spoken voice
must.why: Audio exists with a peak of -1 dB, but the mood and the lack of voice cannot be judged from the numbers.

exact_text.read_as: Not visible in the supplied frames
Not visible in the supplied frames

faults.what: Clip 2 is in the original kitchen and table setting, not the clean grey studio. This breaks the clean-studio look and clashes with clip 1.

Clip 1 shows a re-rendered bottle with a different cap. It has a loop handle and a ribbed base, and the shape is more glossy and CGI than the photo. It also looks nearly static, with little visible movement.
The bottle's look differs between the two clips, so the ad is inconsistent. In clip 2 the cap looks blocky and its detail shifts.
The title cards and the final assembled video were not verifiable. The reply says the file runs 15.8 s, not 15 s.

summary: The two close-ups look like different scenes: clip 1 is a re-rendered studio bottle with a changed cap, and clip 2 is in the original kitchen. The ad is not a clean studio look, and the bottle does not match the photo consistently. The title card text could not be checked.
